newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Intertech sees productivity boon.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Intertech sees productivity boon.

text.p: Commercial Intertech Corp will benefit in 1997 from some capital investments it made this year to improve productivity at its domestic and oversees manufacturing facilities, the company's chairman and chief executive, Paul Powers, said in a statement Wednesday.
The more efficient productivity will mean better results for the company in 1997, he added, although did not make any projections. He could not be immediately reached for comment.
The company on Wednesday reported fourth-quarter earnings of $0.01 a share -- including charges of $0.29 a share -- compared with $0.52 a share in the year-ago period.
